teams.name: Jacksonville Jaguars
teams.note: Still No. 1 after a 33-10 win over the Ravens on the road, with the offense (+2.2 points) leading the way. They're 6-2 with a 98 percent shot at the playoffs, and the Titans are next.

teams.name: San Francisco 49ers
teams.note: The 49ers hold No. 2 at 7-1 after beating the Raiders 38-17. The offense (+4.0 points) is the engine, and a trip to Dallas comes next with the model favoring them by 5.5.

teams.name: Buffalo Bills
teams.note: Four straight wins now, the latest a 23-6 beating of the Vikings on the road, and the Bills move up to No. 3. Their strength of record ranks first, and Josh Allen's offense (+3.5 points) does the heavy lifting.

teams.name: Los Angeles Rams
teams.note: Three wins in a row, including a 20-13 grind against the Commanders, lift the Rams to No. 4. At 5-4 their record lags the rating, with a strength of record rank of 16.

teams.name: Chicago Bears
teams.note: The Bears beat the Buccaneers 27-24 for their fourth straight win, yet slip two spots to No. 5. The model likes them 2.6 points more than the betting market does.

teams.name: Seattle Seahawks
teams.note: Seattle jumps five spots to No. 6, with the quarterback situation worth +2.2 points of the move. The defense (+2.2 points) was the story in a 17-3 win over Arizona.

teams.name: Detroit Lions
teams.note: Four straight wins, the latest a 19-9 road win in Miami, push Detroit up two to No. 7. Injuries swung things by +1.4 points, though players ruled out still cost them 0.8 points.

teams.name: Cincinnati Bengals
teams.note: Cincinnati has won four straight, including 34-17 in Atlanta, and still drops two spots to No. 8. The defense (-1.1 points) is the soft spot, and Pittsburgh visits next.

teams.name: Kansas City Chiefs
teams.note: The Chiefs handled the Jets 35-12 at home and sit at 6-2 with a 91 percent playoff chance. They slide two spots to No. 9 even though their rating rose 0.8 points.

teams.name: Denver Broncos
teams.note: Denver climbs five spots to No. 10 on a five-game winning streak, the latest a 26-21 win at Carolina. The point differential is only 12, but they're 7-2 and 96 percent likely to make the playoffs.

teams.name: Tampa Bay Buccaneers
teams.note: Tampa Bay is 3-6 after a 27-24 loss in Chicago, but the rating (+2.1) still says they're better than that. The model rates them 4.4 points higher than the betting market does.

teams.name: Green Bay Packers
teams.note: A 45-27 win over the Patriots in New England moves the Packers up two to No. 12. The offense (+1.1 points) is their best unit, and the Vikings visit next.

teams.name: New England Patriots
teams.note: The Patriots fall five spots to No. 13 after a 45-27 home loss to the Packers. Their rating dropped 1.2 points, and the defense (-0.0 points) is no longer an asset.

teams.name: Pittsburgh Steelers
teams.note: Pittsburgh was on a bye and slips one spot to No. 14 at 6-2 with four straight wins. The offense (-0.5 points) is the weak link heading to Cincinnati as a 5.2-point underdog.

teams.name: Minnesota Vikings
teams.note: Minnesota fell 23-6 to Buffalo at home and drops three spots to No. 15. Players ruled out cost them 2.2 points, and the offense (-2.8 points) is the problem.

teams.name: Houston Texans
teams.note: Houston beat the Chargers 44-22 but stays at No. 16 at 3-5. Players ruled out cost them 2.4 points, and the model rates them 4.3 points lower than the betting market does.

teams.name: Washington Commanders
teams.note: Washington moves up one to No. 17 despite a 20-13 home loss to the Rams. At 2-5-1 with a playoff chance of 8 percent, the defense (-1.0 points) is the weakest unit.

teams.name: Dallas Cowboys
teams.note: Dallas beat the Colts 27-23 and still falls one spot to No. 18. The defense (-2.1 points) is the problem, and the 49ers come to town next.

teams.name: Carolina Panthers
teams.note: Carolina has lost three straight, the latest 26-21 to the Broncos, yet climbs one spot to No. 19. Injuries helped the rating by +1.4 points.

teams.name: Atlanta Falcons
teams.note: The Falcons dropped a 34-17 game to the Bengals and fall one to No. 20. The offense (-1.9 points) is the weakest unit, and the Chiefs are next.

teams.name: New York Giants
teams.note: The Giants jump four spots to No. 21 after a 19-11 win over the Eagles. They're 5-2-1 with a 69 percent shot at the division, even if the rating is -3.8.

teams.name: Indianapolis Colts
teams.note: Indianapolis has lost five straight, the latest 27-23 to Dallas, and is 2-7 with a point differential of -65. Players ruled out cost them 1.9 points.

teams.name: New York Jets
teams.note: The Jets lost 35-12 to the Chiefs, their fourth straight defeat, and hold at No. 23. The defense (-1.4 points) is the weakest unit, and Buffalo comes to town.

teams.name: Los Angeles Chargers
teams.note: The Chargers are 0-8 after a 44-22 home loss to Houston, yet rise two spots to No. 24. The offense (-3.4 points) is the biggest issue.

teams.name: Cleveland Browns
teams.note: Cleveland leaps six spots to No. 25 even after a 23-22 loss in New Orleans. The quarterback situation is worth +2.8 points, but the offense (-2.9 points) is still a weakness.

teams.name: New Orleans Saints
teams.note: New Orleans edged Cleveland 23-22 and still falls two spots to No. 26. Injuries cost them 1.7 points of rating, and the model rates them 5.5 points lower than the market.

teams.name: Philadelphia Eagles
teams.note: Philadelphia has lost seven straight, the latest 19-11 to the Giants, but moves up three to No. 27. This week's starter puts them 3.5 points below their usual quarterback situation.

teams.name: Baltimore Ravens
teams.note: The Ravens lost 33-10 to Jacksonville at home, their fourth straight loss. This week's starter is 5.7 points below their usual quarterback situation, and the model rates them 7.2 points below the market.

teams.name: Arizona Cardinals
teams.note: Arizona lost 17-3 in Seattle and slips one to No. 29. The quarterback situation cost them 1.2 points, and the Rams visit next as 10.1-point favorites.

teams.name: Las Vegas Raiders
teams.note: The Raiders drop eight spots to No. 30 after a 38-17 loss to the 49ers. The quarterback situation cost 4.1 points, the biggest swing of any team this week.

teams.name: Miami Dolphins
teams.note: Miami is 1-7 after a 19-9 home loss to Detroit and falls four spots to No. 31. The quarterback situation (-2.1 points) and injuries (-1.4 points) both hurt.

teams.name: Tennessee Titans
teams.note: The Titans had a bye and stay at No. 32 with a rating of -9.8. The offense (-2.6 points) is the weakest unit, and Jacksonville is next with the model favoring them by 15.4.
